answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 41343 Country: United Kingdom Title: Zakat on mortgage money Question: If a person has taken mortgage money from a bank and it is in his possession does he have to give zakah on it. Answer ID: 41343 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1459/1081/D=1433) If you mean gold and silver and it is in his possession then in this case he will have to pay zakah of the rest of the amount after deducting the amount equal to loan. And if it is business loan then only the amount equal to the instalments which has to be paid during one year shall be deducted. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
